scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @booking/api && npm run build -w @booking/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api -c gray,cyan "npm run dev -w @booking/shared -- --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @booking/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,web -c gray,magenta "npm run dev -w @booking/shared -- --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @booking/web"
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @booking/shared -- --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @booking/api" "npm run dev -w @booking/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
